body:
sam_sales: @here NOVACARE risk team requested full vulnerability artifacts and remediation timeline for their vendor review. They need: CAIQ answers, pen test report, vuln scan outputs, and an owner + ETA for fixes. Can we assemble a handoff package by EOD?

jordan_se: I can pull the CAIQ + SIG responses. will attach. planning to include our control references and the ticket links.

maya_security: I took the pen test edits last week — redacted PII. I'll upload the sanitized PDF and Nessus/Nmap exports. Need confirmation on what to omit for the customer (stack traces with IPs?).

alex_eng: For the Nessus findings, we have patches queued for 2.54.0; patch rollout ETA 2024-10-08. For config issues flagged (CIS chunges), we can provide remediation steps.

sam_sales: customer asked for checksum+download link. @ops-bot can we place the package in their S3 share and post presigned URL?

ops-bot: created /s3/cox-novacare/vendor-review/1968504321/ package. presigned link: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/cox-novacare/vendor-review/1968504321/package.zip (expires 7d)

jordan_se: checksums: 
```
sha256: 3f7a2b8c9d2e4a1bff3d9f7a2b8c9d2e4a1bff3d9f7a2b8c9d2e4a1bff3d9f7a
md5: 7b8c9d2e4a1bff3d9f7a2b8c
```

maya_security: included files in package: pen_test_sanitized.pdf, nessus_scan_2024-09-15.csv, nmap_tcp_2024-09-15.xml, remediation_notes.md, caiq_answers.yaml, sig_profile.json. Redacted IPs mapped to internal placeholders.

liz_cust_success: FYI I'll send the package to Novacare security contact and confirm acceptance window. They'll want a remediation timeline and designation of 'critical' vs 'non-critical' fixes.

alex_eng: owners + plan: 
- CVE-2024-2890 (token validation) -> owner: @alex_eng -> mitigation: hotfix + config change -> ETA: 2024-09-30 
- Outdated dependency (libXYZ) -> owner: @jordan_se -> mitigation: upgrade -> ETA: 2024-10-05 
- Misconfigured CORS -> owner: @maya_security -> mitigation: policy update -> ETA: 2024-09-27

sam_sales: Can we commit to weekly status updates to Novacare? they request a single point of contact and a target sign-off date of 2024-10-15.

maya_security: weekly updates ok. I'll run the retest after patches land and provide verification artifacts (scan diffs).

jordan_se: adding SIG/CAIQ note — we answered all control statements; marked some as 'partial' pending the fixes above. I'll attach the updated CAIQ doc to the package.

sam_sales: perfect. liz, once Novacare confirms access I'll hand off to you for running through the legal checklist. Also note: we included a short executive summary for legal.

liz_cust_success: noted. will confirm with their vendor risk team and loop back here with the initial acceptance or any follow-up questions.

maya_security: one more: don't share raw exploit PoCs. we've kept PoC descriptions high-level and removed exploit code.

sam_sales: thanks team :thumbsup: — assigning follow-ups: @alex_eng, @jordan_se, @maya_security to update their tickets and post progress here. target: weekly cadence until sign-off (2024-10-15).

ops-bot: uploaded updated_package_v2.zip at https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/cox-novacare/vendor-review/1968504321/updated_package_v2.zip (expires 7d)

jordan_se: confirmed updated CAIQ and SIG attached. last_message: I'll close the loop after Novacare ack.

sam_sales: closing thread when Novacare signs off. thanks everyone.
